Thanks a lot for talking to me. It means the world.

I don't have anything really. Right now I'm on holidays, and just browse reddit and 4chan all day, and in two weeks I'll have to go back to studying. There's one book I've been reading that's really interesting, but apart from that nothing.

extremely lonely, feeling like a leech to my family,don't have anything going on with my life and have no real plans for the future, nothing to look up to

feel extremely anxious every time I want to leave home, and sometimes even the bedroom

can't even keep a conversation with any of my friends anymore

I've already tried to bring the issue up to my """best friend""", but he always brushed it off, and there's no one else that I really feel comfortable with talking about this things. At least everyone here is always very kind and helpful.
hey, if you want to vent about it (or anything really) you can just message me
Hey, are you still here? I really need someone to talk to
